$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the multi-target build. Edit this, then run `npm run build`. Each plugin carries its own `version`: both harnesses resolve updates per plugin from it (Claude Code skips `claude plugin update` when the resolved version matches its cache; Codex uses it as the install cache key), so bump the version of EVERY plugin whose generated plugins/<name>/ dir changes in a PR — including plugins that merely bundle a changed dependency — and leave the others untouched. `marketplace.version` is catalog metadata only and does not drive updates. While iterating within a PR, uninstall/reinstall to refresh a local install. CI (`npm test`) fails if the generated files drift. A plugin composes with other plugins two ways: `dependencies` is a build-time CLOSURE — the build bundles every dependency's skills+hooks+agents into the self-contained plugins/<name>/ dir that BOTH harnesses install (no native, Claude-only resolution, so Claude Code and Codex install identically). `requires` is a documented-only dependency — NOT bundled and NOT auto-installed; the user installs it themselves. Use `requires` when a plugin builds on another but shouldn't ship a copy of it. `tools` (per plugin) pins the CLI tools its skills and hooks invoke: canonical sources write the literal `uvx <name>@x.y.z` placeholder, and the build substitutes each bundling plugin's pin into its generated plugins/<name>/ copies — see the astra plugin's tools $comment for the full mechanism.

marketplace.name: lightcone-research
marketplace.description: Agent skills for Lightcone Research — ASTRA and scientific paper reproduction.

plugins.name: astra
plugins.description: Reference for the ASTRA specification (astra.yaml): top-level structure, sub-analyses, inputs/outputs, decisions and options, prior insights and findings, evidence and quote verification, and composition mechanics. Invoke when reading, writing, validating, or debugging an astra.yaml spec, or when the user asks about ASTRA schema or sub-analysis composition. Ships hooks that validate astra.yaml on save and remind agents to load the skill when they read an ASTRA file.

tools.$comment: Pins for the CLI tools this plugin's skills and hooks invoke via `uvx <name>@<version>`. Canonical skills/ and hooks/ write the literal `@x.y.z` placeholder — never a concrete version — and `npm run build` substitutes each bundling plugin's pin into the generated plugins/<name>/ copies.

plugins.name: reproduction
plugins.description: Scientific paper replication workflows: assess candidate papers for reproducibility (`assess-reproducibility`), carry out a complete independently verified replication (`reproduce`), and compare reproduced figures, tables, and values with the originals (`figure-comparison`). Bundles the ASTRA reference and validation hooks, so this plugin is self-contained for reproduction work.
